items: Even side characters get their own arc eventually.
Save often. Resting counts as leveling up.
Every bug is just a plot twist waiting for its resolution.
Growth arcs look slow from the inside and obvious from the outside.
The main character always debugs alone at 2am at least once.
Soft heart, sharp logic — you can have both stats maxed out.
Not every quest needs to be completed today.
Some of the best training arcs happen quietly, off-screen.
